dedupeText: melancholic bistro portrait 1970s aesthetic bistro table melancholy serif typography patterned wallpaper cinematic lighting letterboxed subject positioned off center left balanced by an empty white chair on the right warm table lighting contrasting with the dark repetitive wallpaper pattern typography aligned to the top left and bottom right margins of the central image frame combine a cinematic horizontal slice of a domestic bistro scene with heavy black letterboxing and high contrast serif typography placed in the margins

recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic, letterboxed composition featuring a woman seated at a small round bistro table against a dark patterned wallpaper. The scene is framed by heavy black bars at the top and bottom, with elegant serif typography placed within these negative spaces.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned off-center left, balanced by an empty white chair on the right.
Warm table lighting contrasting with the dark, repetitive wallpaper pattern.
Typography aligned to the top-left and bottom-right margins of the central image frame.
coreInvariants: Horizontal image strip centered between two solid black blocks.
Small round table with a brown tablecloth as the central anchor.
Single red rose in a glass vase providing the primary color accent.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a woman on the left third; table occupies the lower center of the image strip.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The round table with white coffee cups and wine glasses.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-left text, down to the woman's face, across the table to the empty chair, and finally to the bottom-right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant solid black blocks at the top (approx. 10%) and bottom (approx. 40%) of the total canvas.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark charcoal (background and framing).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm browns and muted purples (tablecloth and clothing).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white (chairs, cups) and a single pop of red (rose).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white furniture and the dark environment.

letterConstructionRules: Significant stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
Italicized for the bottom text to imply emotion or motion

composition.position: Top left corner of the image frame
composition.relationshipToImage: Floating in the top black margin

composition.position: Bottom right corner of the image frame
composition.relationshipToImage: Floating in the bottom black margin

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same typeface family using Roman vs. Italic styles for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic high-contrast serif with elegant italic forms.
Traditional transitional serif that matches the 70s-80s aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic horizontal strip showing a woman in a purple blouse sitting at a bistro table with a brown cloth, two coffee cups, and a single red rose. The background is a dark, small-patterned wallpaper. The strip is sandwiched between a thin black bar at the top and a thick black bar at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add cream-colored serif text in all-caps to the top-left margin and italicized title-case serif text to the bottom-right margin, just outside the image boundary.

verificationChecks: Is the image letterboxed between two solid black areas?
Is there an empty white chair balancing the subject?
Is the bottom text italicized and right-aligned?
Is the color of the text a muted cream or pale gold?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the black framing bars
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the woman
Any brand logos on the coffee cups
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red rose is the only vibrant color pop.
Check that the black bars are perfectly horizontal and solid.
Verify the high-contrast serif anatomy of the letters.
Confirm the 'empty chair' narrative element is present.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a cinematic horizontal slice of a domestic/bistro scene with heavy black letterboxing and high-contrast serif typography placed in the margins.
